question: Fiscal Health Index (FHI) 2025 has been released by which organization?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NITI Aayog**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 __ 
• **Fiscal Health Index (FHI) 2025** has been released by the **NITI Aayog**, which is India’s premier policy think tank. 
• The **Fiscal Health Index** is designed to assess the fiscal performance and health of Indian states, enabling better financial planning and governance. 
• The index considers key fiscal parameters such as **revenue generation, expenditure management, debt sustainability, and fiscal deficit reduction**. 
• This initiative aims to promote **transparency and accountability** in state finances and encourage states to adopt fiscally responsible practices. 
• The **NITI Aayog** works in collaboration with state governments, leveraging this index to provide tailored fiscal recommendations and support. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **About NITI Aayog:** 
• **Full Form:** National Institution for Transforming India. 
• It was established in **2015**, replacing the **Planning Commission**. 
• It acts as a **policy think tank** for the Indian government, focusing on fostering cooperative federalism. 
• The organization provides strategic and technical advice to the Central and State governments. 
• **Purpose of Fiscal Health Index:** 
• To identify fiscal challenges faced by states and promote financial discipline. 
• To highlight the **revenue and expenditure patterns** of states for better fiscal management. 
• To encourage states to implement reforms that ensure long-term fiscal sustainability. 
• **Other Key Reports by NITI Aayog:** 
• **SDG India Index:** Tracks progress on **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** at the national and sub-national levels. 
• **Health Index:** Measures the health outcomes and systems performance of Indian states and union territories. 
• **Export Preparedness Index:** Evaluates the export readiness and performance of Indian states. 
• **Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act:** 
• Enacted in **2003**, this act aims to ensure fiscal discipline by reducing fiscal deficits and managing public debt. 
• The FRBM Act sets targets for the **fiscal deficit-to-GDP ratio** and public debt-to-GDP ratio. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **NITI Aayog’s Role in Fiscal Policy:** 
• NITI Aayog plays a vital role in providing state-specific fiscal recommendations to improve financial stability. 
• Its initiatives help promote **data-driven decision-making** and ensure resource optimization in states. 
• **State Fiscal Reforms:** 
• Several Indian states have implemented fiscal reforms, such as **e-governance systems, GST compliance, and debt management frameworks**, to improve fiscal health. 
• States like **Maharashtra** and **Gujarat** have been recognized for innovative fiscal management practices.
